verdict.rationale: The only evidence is a bare 'Generative AI features' line on Mailchimp's own pricing page. That suggests a built-in generative capability, but it never says the feature drafts or refines subject lines or email copy from a brief inside the composer. The 'AI you already use… without leaving the chat' item describes external AI assistants, not the built-in composer, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: documentation that the AI generates or refines subject lines and body copy, brief-based prompting, in-composer placement, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can have the platform's built-in AI draft or refine subject lines and email copy from a brief, inside the composer
